## 更新内容

- 支持将已识别的 ChatGPT 卡片、分栏和流程布局转换为顺序排列的 Markdown，保留正文、代码、图片和方向箭头。
- 引用优先还原为来源链接；无法解析的引用保留原标记并明确标注。
- 保留图片本地化、本地编辑保护和未知 HTML 检查。颜色和并排样式不保留。

通过 BRAT 更新 `elfmedy/obsidian-ai-inbox`。要修复浏览器端“包含不支持的 HTML 内容”错误，请同时安装 [浏览器扩展 0.5.4](https://github.com/elfmedy/browser-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.4)，重新加载扩展并刷新聊天页面。已有配对和笔记无需删除。

兼容浏览器扩展 0.3.0+ 的 ChatGPT 保存请求；Gemini / Claude 需要扩展 0.5.0+。本次布局捕获修复需要扩展 0.5.4。

## What's new

- Convert supported ChatGPT cards, columns and flow layouts to sequential Markdown, retaining text, code, images and directional arrows.
- Resolve citations using source metadata; keep unresolved markers with an explicit label.
- Preserve local image handling, local-edit protection and checks for unknown HTML. Colors and side-by-side styling are not retained.

Update through BRAT. Install [browser extension 0.5.4](https://github.com/elfmedy/browser-ai-inbox/releases/tag/0.5.4), reload the extension and refresh the chat to fix the browser's unsupported-HTML error. Keep existing pairing and notes.

Compatible with browser extension 0.3.0+ for ChatGPT and 0.5.0+ for Gemini / Claude; the new layout capture fix requires 0.5.4.

Alpha · Desktop Obsidian 1.12.0+ · Manual installation: `main.js` and `manifest.json`.
